title: Gorard and Wolfram hypergraph physics project recovers GR and quantum mechanics

tellings.quote: and so that is that was like his breakthrough result in 2020 2021 and And that was like really suggestive, right?

plain: In 2020 and 2021, a physicist named Jonathan Gorard, working with the scientist Stephen Wolfram, is said to have shown that simple networks of linked points, called hypergraphs, can produce both Einstein's theory of gravity and quantum mechanics. A guest named Matthew Pines relays this, calling it Gorard's "breakthrough result" and "really suggestive," linking it to Wolfram's book A New Kind of Science and to a researcher named Xerxes Arsiwalla. If it holds, the two great theories of physics could come from one deeper rule.
